claude-code.label: Claude Code
claude-code.note: Run in the background in the game's own agent folder. --tools "" takes every built-in tool away (no shell, no files, no web); --strict-mcp-config and --allowedTools leave it only The Optimizer's toolbox and the game's connector. The run uses your own Claude account.

other.label: other MCP agents (untested)
other.note: Any AI agent that runs on this PC can do the job if it has: (1) MCP servers over stdio (it is given runner/<game>/agent/mcp.json: the toolbox and the game's connector); (2) a mode that runs on its own from a prompt, with no one answering questions (the prompt is job/job.md); (3) a way to allow only those MCP tools and nothing else (no shell, no file writing). Not tried: The Optimizer is built and tested with Claude Code only. Add an entry here with its command line in the same shape as claude-code's.
